name: use-graph-viewport
description: Pan and zoom for a drawn graph, in place of d3-zoom: a drag on the ground pans (after 4px, so a click is still a click), pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zooms about the pointer while a plain wheel is left to the page, and the view follows the content — fitting when the frame is measured and when the drawing grows — until someone takes it over. Every gesture has a key, returned as onKeyDown for the component to call first: + and - zoom, 0 fits, Shift + an arrow pans. One transform, returned as a style, moves the HTML nodes and the SVG edges together.
